mechanism_contracts.security_subject_or_principal: Web user (authenticated or unauthenticated) invoking a controller/service endpoint
mechanism_contracts.protected_target_or_security_object: Application resource identified by an ID/key (e.g., user profile, dashboard, message, index)
mechanism_contracts.attacker_controlled_input_or_trigger: Identifier obtained from HTTP request inputs (query parameter, header, path/body parameter via web frameworks)
mechanism_contracts.decisive_security_relation: Ownership/authorization of the current principal over the resource identified by the supplied ID/key
mechanism_contracts.required_validation_or_authorization_con: Server-side must derive/verify the target ID against the authenticated context or perform an explicit ownership/authorization check before the operation
mechanism_contracts.security_sensitive_effect: Directly performing a sensitive operation (delete/update/modify/share/etc.) on the resource designated by the attacker-controlled ID/key

mechanism_contracts.security_subject_or_principal: Peer/client or user presenting identity/configuration keys
mechanism_contracts.protected_target_or_security_object: Cluster membership or security-sensitive configuration options
mechanism_contracts.attacker_controlled_input_or_trigger: User-controlled identity component (e.g., SASL instance part) or configuration key whose absence/value influences authorization
mechanism_contracts.decisive_security_relation: Authorization logic branches based on presence/value of the key; missing/optional component causes checks to be skipped
mechanism_contracts.required_validation_or_authorization_con: Enforce presence and validation of the key/identity component before allowing privileged operation
mechanism_contracts.security_sensitive_effect: Join a cluster or toggle sensitive parameters without proper authorization

mechanism_contracts.security_subject_or_principal: Holder of an SCA certificate used to authenticate to the service
mechanism_contracts.attacker_controlled_input_or_trigger: Certificate-derived identity/key accepted without sufficient scoping/constraints
mechanism_contracts.decisive_security_relation: Mapping from certificate attributes to authorized identity is too permissive
mechanism_contracts.required_validation_or_authorization_con: Tight validation and scoping of certificate usage to intended identities/contexts
mechanism_contracts.security_sensitive_effect: Gain/abuse authenticated access beyond intended scope

codeql_mappings.source_predicate_or_condition: Sources are HTTP request-derived values: returns of javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest.getParameter/getHeader/getQueryString and web-exposed handler parameters (Spring @*Mapping, JAX-RS @PathParam/@QueryParam/@FormParam)
codeql_mappings.target_predicate_or_condition: Sinks are call arguments to methods whose names indicate sensitive resource operations (delete/remove/update/modify/set/save/change/grant/revoke/share/unshare/bind/assign/disable/enable/approve/reject/clear/reset/subscribe/unsubscribe/cancel/close/open/start/stop) where the specific argument is ID-like (variable/field name contains id/uuid/key/token or request accessor called with an id-like literal)
codeql_mappings.relation_or_validation_predicate: Heuristically exclude flows in methods that clearly access an authorization context (Principal/Authentication parameter or use SecurityContextHolder)
codeql_mappings.query_branch_or_join_condition: Taint flow from sources to the exact sink argument expression via DataFlow and a join on the argument index
codeql_mappings.bounded_limitation_if_not_encoded: Ownership checks expressed via custom methods or annotations are not recognized; the presence of auth context does not guarantee proper checks, it only reduces false positives

codeql_mappings.source_predicate_or_condition: User-controlled or missing identity/configuration component influencing authorization branches
codeql_mappings.target_predicate_or_condition: Privileged operations gated by conditional checks on the presence/value of the component
codeql_mappings.relation_or_validation_predicate: Path-sensitive detection of skipped checks due to absent instance/key
codeql_mappings.query_branch_or_join_condition: Requires control-flow/semantic understanding of authorization logic tied to optional components
codeql_mappings.bounded_limitation_if_not_encoded: Generic CodeQL query without repository-specific models cannot reliably encode this control-flow based bypass; omitted to avoid undue false positives

codeql_mappings.source_predicate_or_condition: Certificate-based identities accepted from external clients
codeql_mappings.target_predicate_or_condition: Authentication/authorization routines trusting certificate attributes as identity keys
codeql_mappings.relation_or_validation_predicate: Improper mapping/scoping checks for certificate use
codeql_mappings.query_branch_or_join_condition: Requires protocol- and repository-specific modeling of certificate validation logic
codeql_mappings.bounded_limitation_if_not_encoded: Out of scope for a general static pattern without deep framework/protocol models; not encoded
